quick.quote: Fixed versions: 1.30.0 (1.x) and 2.2.0 (2.x). Published November 19, 2026 (NVD published November 16, 2026). Affected 1.9.1 through 1.29.1; 2.0.0 through 2.1.1 in some conditions.

quick.name: Python MCP SDK OAuth leak: no workaround claim
quick.quote: On earlier versions there is no workaround other than connecting OAuth-enabled clients only to MCP servers you trust. (Same advisory also lists: set issuer= on ClientCredentialsOAuthProvider/PrivateKeyJWTOAuthProvider, migrate off RFC7523OAuthClientProvider, clear stored OAuth client info, rotate/revoke secrets and tokens.)
quick.fix: 'No workaround' applies only to earlier (unpatched) versions. Advisory has post-upgrade steps the brief omits: set issuer= on the two providers (upgrading alone does not change their behaviour), clear stored client registrations once, rotate the client secret and revoke tokens if a client may have met an untrusted server. Not affected: servers built with the SDK, stdio clients, clients that attach their own tokens.
